newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms seek up to 52,500 tonnes of corn.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms seek up to 52,500 tonnes of corn.

text.p: A South Korean buyers group, known as the Big Feed Mills, has invited a tender to buy up to 52,500 tonnes of corn by 4:00 p.m. (0700 GMT) on Wednesday, officials of the buyers group said.
They said the buyers group wanted to buy either 30,000 tonnes for arrival by October 15 or 52,500 tonnes for arrival by October 20 to the western port of Inchon.

Shipment of the October 15 arrival was set for September 26-October 15 if sourced from China, for September 11-30 if from the Pacific Northwest, for August 27-September 15 if from the U.S. Gulf, or for August 22-September 10 if from South America.
